hold_text: PROP-EXEC lane brief (manager session_01KAQRJxRbRwpYTkPgBjNVyQ): every PR in this lane is held; the manager merges. Do not arm auto-merge.
why: PROP-EXEC fix-forward #10: the watched close rebuilt to the operator's exact flow (screenshots 2026-09-29, manager 07:20Z). DXtradeAdapter.flatten now: locates the ONE Positions row for the symbol and reads back its Side / Size / Fill against the position the caller means to close (any mismatch refuses before the hover); hovers the row (the reverse / modify / close icon trio appears on hover); tags the close control only when exactly one close-type control exists, it is the LAST control of the row, it is boxed inside the row and away from any canvas (chart overlays carry their own x); disarmed stops there. Armed: clicks that one control, reads the Close Position modal back (heading names OUR symbol and side, lots-to-close and the '<n> out of <n>' caption equal the full size, exactly one enabled Close Position button; lots never edited), presses Close Position only after every read-back, else presses Discard and refuses with the reason. The reverse and modify icons, the chart's overlay x and a panel-level x are never pressed. Replicas in a real Chromium: the hover-revealed trio + modal (close confirmed once, row gone); wrong side / size / fill rows; close not last, not unique, absent, or reverse-looking; a modal naming the other side or another symbol, lots-to-close 0.005, caption total 0.02, no caption (each presses Discard, the row stays); no control at all with only chart/panel x's. NOT in this PR: the executor / tick / action-shell / workflow wiring (expected facts passed from run_round_trip, the post-close orphan-order and margin checks, and a close-position mode that journals an existing position): that batch was denied by the session's auto-mode classifier and is left for the manager. Tier 2: the live close path on a funded account; no new click beyond the operator's own two (row x, Close Position); no sizing, guard or risk change.
